name: Greece — Greek parties
intro: compare it with Greek political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Greece: those represented in the parliament (Vouli ton Ellinon) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Vouli ton Ellinon) after the 2023 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 300 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

KKE.name: Kommounistiko Komma Elladas
KKE.priorities: Workers' rights and wages, Public services, National sovereignty
KKE.description: Orthodox Communist Party, opposed to the EU and NATO, with a disciplined base among workers.

SYRIZA.name: SYRIZA
SYRIZA.priorities: Public services, Workers' rights and wages, Affordable housing
SYRIZA.description: Radical-left coalition that governed under Alexis Tsipras from 2015 to 2019 and has since split and lost ground.

NA.name: Nea Aristera
NA.priorities: Public services, Climate action, Civil liberties
NA.description: New Left, formed in 2024 by MPs who left SYRIZA.

Plefsi.name: Plefsi Eleftherias
Plefsi.priorities: Justice reform, Fighting corruption, National sovereignty
Plefsi.description: Course of Freedom, a left-populist party led by former parliamentary speaker Zoe Konstantopoulou.

PASOK.name: PASOK–KINAL
PASOK.priorities: Public healthcare, Public services, Deeper European integration
PASOK.description: Historic socialist party, second in recent polls and the main opposition force.

Volt.name: Volt Greece
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

ND.name: Nea Dimokratia
ND.priorities: Competitiveness and growth, Defence and support for Ukraine, Reducing immigration
ND.description: New Democracy of Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis, governing with a majority since 2019.

Niki.name: Niki
Niki.priorities: Christian values, Traditional family values, National identity

EL.name: Elliniki Lysi
EL.priorities: Reducing immigration, National identity, National sovereignty
EL.description: Greek Solution, a nationalist party led by Kyriakos Velopoulos.

Foni Logikis.name: Foni Logikis
Foni Logikis.priorities: Reducing immigration, Traditional family values, Security and law and order
Foni Logikis.description: Voice of Reason, a far-right party that won a European Parliament seat in 2024 and sits with the Patriots for Europe.
